Uttarakhand CM flags off waste management vehicles

Uttarakhand Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami flagged off 15 vehicles for waste management. Seven of these vehicles are electric and intended for garbage collection in villages. The corporate sector has come forward to support this initiative. The event took place in Khatima.
